name: Phase 1.5 gate review script — generate-phase1-5-gate.ts + /gate Telegram command
goal: Build Phase 1.5 gate review infrastructure: (1) scripts/scs001/generate-phase1-5-gate.ts — reads manual-posts.jsonl, computes gate criteria (>=30 posts AND >=500 views), writes workspace/gates/phase1-5-gate.json with pass/fail and PROCEED/KILL recommendation. (2) /gate Telegram command — calls the same gate logic and sends formatted gate status to operator. Mirrors the phase0-phase1-gate.json pattern.
rationale: Apr 7 gate decision requires a formal gate artifact (JSON) to document the decision. The operator needs to run /gate on Apr 7 to get an immediate pass/fail recommendation. Without this, the gate is informal and undocumented. Phase 1.5 gate = key kill switch: <500 views/30 posts → kill TikTok, pivot Achiri-only.
swarm: NOT USED — standalone script + 1 new command + 1 new dispatch case. Direct write.

tasks.title: scripts/scs001/generate-phase1-5-gate.ts — formal gate review script
tasks.description: Reads workspace/scs001/manual-posts.jsonl. Computes: posts_count, total_views, avg_views, passes_posts (>=30), passes_views (>=500), overall_pass. Writes workspace/gates/phase1-5-gate.json. Fields: gate, date, criteria[{id,name,pass,details}], overall_pass, recommendation (PROCEED→Phase 2A | KILL→shut down TikTok, focus Achiri). Prints summary to console. Exit 0 on pass, 1 on fail.

tasks.title: commands.ts + index.ts — /gate Telegram command
tasks.description: Add handleGate(chatId) to commands.ts: reads manual-posts.jsonl, computes same gate criteria, sends formatted message with gate status, days until Apr 7, and PROCEED/KILL recommendation. Add case '/gate' in index.ts dispatch switch.
